# Sample Markdown Source

This is a small Markdown fixture used by the Phase 2 ingestion tests. It has
a short introduction and two sections so the structure-aware chunker has real
headings to split on.

## Psychological Safety

Psychological safety is a shared belief that a team is safe for interpersonal
risk taking. On psychologically safe teams, members feel able to admit
mistakes, ask questions, and propose ideas without fear of being punished or
humiliated. The concept matters because learning behavior, such as seeking
feedback and discussing errors openly, depends on it.

## Team Learning

Teams that learn well treat errors as information rather than as failures of
character. They run small experiments, review the results honestly, and adjust.
This habit compounds: each cycle of trying, observing, and revising leaves the
team a little better at the work and a little better at learning itself.
